attr.title: Pancito Merge
attr.desc: Drop, stack, and merge colorful pan dulce into bigger, tastier treats in this cozy puzzle adventure! With charming visuals and simple gameplay, it’s a sweet celebration of Mexican baking, perfect for quick sessions and high score chases.
attr.inst_md:
**ES**

1. Compra PancitoMerge en Steam
2. Ve al directorio donde se encuentra el archivo PCK, normalmente se encuentra en: 

**Linux:**

```bash
/home/TuUsuario/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/PancitoMerge/PancitoMerge.pck
```
**Windows:**

```bash
C:\Program Files (x86)\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PancitoMerge\PancitoMerge.pck
```

3.  Exporta este archivo a tu consola en la carpeta /roms/ports/PancitoMerge/PancitoMerge/

4. Ejecuta el juego y ¡Disfruta!

**EN**

1. Buy Pancito Merge on Steam
2. Go to the PCK directory. You normaly found it on:

**Linux:**
```bash
/home/TuUsuario/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/PancitoMerge/PancitoMerge.pck
```
**Windows:**
```bash
C:\Program Files (x86)\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PancitoMerge\PancitoMerge.pck
```
3. Export the pck file to you console on the directory /roms/ports/PancitoMerge/PancitoMerge/
4. Run and Enjoy!
